description: This file defines a utility class 'EmailUtils' for building email content components such as message placeholders and logo paths used in email templates within the application.

classes.name: EmailUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate email template variables such as store information, disclaimers, and logo paths for email communications.

methods.name: createEmailObjectsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of email template variables including store information, disclaimers, and the store logo image URL based on the provided store, message utility, and locale.
